user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: Search results in ChatGPT.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to opt out of ChatGPT search answers.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate the safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training generative AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform user-initiated actions and browsing in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited upon specific user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.opt_out: User-initiated actions; robots.txt rules may not apply.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content for training dataset development.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites at users' direction to answer questions.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated web requests and content retrieval.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Analyzes web content to improve search response relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Web search result quality and optimization indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google's search indexes and product-specific crawls.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, Google News, and related search features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images, logos, and favicons for Google Search and image products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Search features presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related search features and products.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content specifically for Google News products.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Googlebot-News in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls information for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Storebot-Google in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Powers Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Affects Search testing tools in Search Console; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-InspectionTool in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler fetching publicly accessible content for various product teams and R&D.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product; used for internal research and development.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product; generic image fetching.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Image in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect any specific product; generic video fetching.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for GoogleOther-Video in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes site owner-requested crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls for building Vertex AI Agents; no effect on Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-CloudVertexBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training for Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps.
user_agents.scope: Affects training future Gemini models and grounding with Google Search on Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow rules for Google-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Apple products and training for foundation models.
user_agents.scope: General web crawling for search in Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and AI context.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled website content for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Controls data usage for generative AI training without crawling webpages directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps to display previews.
user_agents.scope: Content of an app or website shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Online web content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for improving advertising and business-related products.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models and indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models and improving products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request to support agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to build index for Bing search and AI features.
user_agents.scope: Public web content.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent: Bingbot.

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates rich previews and retrieval for Microsoft services and Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Public web content requested for preview or answer generation.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent: MicrosoftPreview.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates snapshots and previews in search results.
user_agents.scope: Public web pages.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for User-agent: BingPreview.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web pages crawled for improving products, services, and AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt disallow directives or page-level robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Content eligible for Amazon search experiences; not used for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify disallow directives for Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user actions by fetching live web information on user demand.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated live web requests for queries; not used for generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler building an open copy of the web for research.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected subset of the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Specify User-agent: CCBot with Disallow in robots.txt or use opt-out registry.
